description.value:
You've learned to summon a raging storm in a 30-foot radius around yourself. As an action, you can gain the following for 1 minute: a flying speed equal to your walking speed; resistance to energy, lightning, and necrotic damage; and any hostile creature that enters the radius for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, takes 10 lightning damage.

The storm ends early if you are incapacitated or die. Once used, you can't use this feature again until you complete a long rest.
